Why were tiny, cheap pocket pistols so popular among criminals? Known as "Saturday Night Specials," these small, easily concealed handguns were inexpensive and often treated as disposable weapons. From .25 and .32 caliber pistols to snub-nosed .38 revolvers, they were easy to hide, but their limited capacity and sometimes questionable reliability came with serious drawbacks!
